fixes.problem: Flow f1 still fails: s06 has no text field to type into. The 'Ask Teacher' composer is drawn as static text, so the type gesture cannot work. Round 1 asked for this and it was not fixed.
fixes.fix: Turn the 'Ask Teacher' placeholder in the composer (x 8-403, y ~717-808) into a real <input> or <textarea> with placeholder 'Ask Teacher'. Use 16px font, color #b0b0b0 placeholder, transparent background, no border, and place it at the same position as the current text. Keep the data-el tag on the box.

fixes.fix: Redraw the hero centered at x=207 from y=0 to 165: orange hair (#e8805c), pale face, mint sweater (#8fd6b8) fading into the input bar. Remove the dark strip. Keep the prompt bar above it with a translucent dark fill.

fixes.problem: The hero collage faces do not match the real ones. The real collage has a braided woman with tan skin on a blue card, a smiling bearded man on a light-blue card, and a purple-haired woman on a light-blue card. The mock has generic faces with different hair and colors.
fixes.fix: Redraw the three portrait cards at the same positions. Use a braided brown-blonde hairstyle on the left with dark top, a bearded smiling man with dark hair in a green sweater on the right, and long purple hair with a dark top on the front card. Keep the green plus tile.

fixes.problem: The subtitle text is wider than the real text, spanning x 27-384 versus the real 31-381, and the heading is heavier.
fixes.fix: Set the subtitle to 14px with weight 400 and a width of about 350px. Set the heading to weight 600. Keep the 2-line wrap at 'everything / they can do for you.'

fixes.problem: The modal title and body text are bolder and shifted about 2px left. The 'Meet me' icon is a black cat where the real one is a small dark Toki head.
fixes.fix: Set the title to weight 600 and the body to weight 400, and shift both right by 2px. Replace the button icon with a small dark rounded Toki head with ears, 20px, at x~161.

fixes.problem: The header avatar is a flat face with different hair. The title 'Teacher' is bolder than the real one. The first chat line is cut differently: the real screen shows a clipped 'you'd like to talk about today?' under the pill, while the mock shows it in full.
fixes.fix: Use the orange-haired teacher avatar in the 48px circle. Set the title to weight 600. Shift the clipped text up by about 3px so it is cut off by the 'Our new chat' pill.

fixes.problem: Text throughout, including the titles, card labels and tab labels, renders heavier and about 1px off. The heatmap shows red outlines on all of it.
fixes.fix: Lower the font weight of text by one step (600 to 500, 500 to 400). Shift 'Keep chatting' and the card titles down by 1px.

summary: Layout is very close: every data-el is within tolerance and there are no failed taps or contract errors. The main structural problem is that flow f1 fails because the Ask Teacher composer is not a real input. The remaining loss is illustration accuracy (hero character, avatars, Bestie collage) and slightly heavy text weights.
